modhub.modhub.optionsLook.desc: Mod Hub's screens look like the Options screens. Off, they use the grey inventory look.
modhub.modhub.adaptOtherLibraries: Other mods' settings in Mod Hub's style
modhub.modhub.adaptOtherLibraries.desc: Mods whose settings are built with YACL, Cloth Config, MidnightLib or Forge Config API Port open as Mod Hub pages. Off, each opens its own settings screen.
